name: Narset
description: Narset is a Planeswalker of Tarkir, a Jeskai monk who became khan and later waymaster of the Jeskai, known as the student of Ojutai and for the Stormnexus Ritual that drove off the dragonlords.

summary.text: Narset is a Planeswalker of Tarkir, a Jeskai monk who became khan and later waymaster of the Jeskai, known as the student of Ojutai and for the Stormnexus Ritual that drove off the dragonlords.

bio.text: In one telling, the young Narset is a restless girl who trains under Ojutai from afar, is named his youngest Master at fifteen, then finds a forbidden archive that contradicts his teaching, learns that Ojutai led the attack on the khans, ignites her spark and walks away from Tarkir.

As khan of the Jeskai she was an outsider among the elders who studied the Annals for a way to heal a war-sick Tarkir, and she fought off Disowned orc assassins said to have been hired by her former pupil Taigam.

In the original timeline she was Sarkhan's friend and was killed by Zurgo while holding him off so Sarkhan could reach the Nexus, and after the time jump Sarkhan resolved to have dragons waiting for her when she lived again.

In the new timeline Taigam told Sarkhan that she had been punished as a heretic, but Sarkhan found her as a Planeswalker exile who had traveled beyond Tarkir, and she chose to stay on Tarkir to study Atarka's histories.

Years later, as waymaster of the Jeskai, she remembered binding herself to the dragon Shiko and driving the dragonlords into the storm, and she feared that the ritual had destabilized Tarkir after her spark guttered out.

When Elspeth arrived, Narset secretly left the monastery with her, was detained by Abzan scouts, and led her through a dragonstorm to a hidden temple and the Meditation Realm, where they met Jace, Ugin and Bolas.
As the realm unmade itself she rescued Loot and fled, then fought Sarkhan's dragon flock beside Elspeth and Ajani, recovering her inner center, until Ugin arrived and the wild dragons fled.

status.text: Narset was last seen alive at the end of the Tarkir: Dragonstorm story, when Ugin arrived and the wild dragons fled.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Taigam, taught by Narset, leaves the Jeskai and travels to Purugir seeking work, drawing Sultai interest.
timeline.quote: He didn't set out to join another clan.

timeline.summary: Taigam learns that Narset sent the surviving monk, has the monk crushed, and suspects the monks were zealots acting without her.
timeline.quote: They were zealots, most likely acting without her knowledge.

timeline.summary: Narset meditates among a hundred monks in the plaza, outwardly serene while her mind races.
timeline.quote: But just because I look quiet and serene doesn't mean I am.

timeline.summary: Narset recalls growing up an outsider who retreated into imaginary worlds, then undertaking the Way of the Wandering Warrior and being appointed khan by the elders.
timeline.quote: my counsel was sought out by many regarding these matters, until the elders saw to appoint me the khan of the Jeskai.

timeline.summary: Narset secretly sticks her tongue out at a bored child during meditation.
timeline.quote: I stuck my tongue out quickly and he covered his mouth with both hands, apparently trying to stifle a gasp.

timeline.summary: Narset ends the session by reciting a traditional saying that she privately dislikes.
timeline.quote: Our own selves are the greatest obstacles to enlightenment,

timeline.summary: Narset slips away from her required solitary meditation, leaving a decoy with a melon for a head to fool her guard Shintan.
timeline.quote: I quickly constructed my decoy, dressed in the same clothes, complete with a melon for a head I had stored here the night before.

timeline.summary: Narset reads the Annals in the stronghold's depths, learning of clans working together against the dragons and of Ugin and Bolas, but cannot decipher Ugin's runes.
timeline.quote: I learned that a dragon named Ugin was connected to Tarkir in ways the khans couldn't comprehend, and that some had claimed Ugin was gone, but not dead.

timeline.summary: Returning to the pavilion, Narset finds eight Disowned orcs holding Shintan and her decoy destroyed.
timeline.quote: I made it to the rock face and climbed back up to the pavilion to find eight Abzan orcs standing within.

timeline.summary: Narset ambushes the orcs, killing one with a palm strike to the heart, kicking two, and turning their commander against his own soldiers.
timeline.quote: I landed in front of the orc and spun around, striking left of the center of the orc's chest, having timed his heart's pumping to stop it with my palm.

timeline.summary: Shintan frees himself and defeats his captors, and the two end the fight with orcs dead and wounded on the marble floor.
timeline.quote: The orcs lay, some dead, all bleeding, on the marble floor of the sacred temple.

timeline.summary: Shintan reports that an orc said Taigam hired them in revenge for an assassination attempt Narset allegedly sent; Narset denies knowing of any assassins.
timeline.quote: He said he and his kin were hired by the rat Taigam.

timeline.summary: The imprisoned orcs all tell the same story, but the elders accept that they are lying; Narset concludes Tarkir is sick with war.
timeline.quote: Tarkir was sick with war.

timeline.summary: Narset meditates atop a mountain peak, stops seeking an answer, and begins to dream of the worlds from her youth.
timeline.quote: The worlds from my youth rush toward me.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan grieves that Narset died and cries out to Ugin, realizing the voice in his head is gone.
timeline.quote: The ceaseless whispering, the constant flow of Ugin's words in his head—the voice was gone!

timeline.summary: Sarkhan sees antlered dragons on Tarkir and realizes that the gate has taken him to Tarkir's past, as Narset's scrolls foretold.
timeline.quote: And it had led him to the past. It had led him here.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan resolves to make sure dragons are waiting for Narset when she lives again on Tarkir, believing the past is gone and this is a new Tarkir.
timeline.quote: when Narset lived again on Tarkir, there would be dragons waiting for her.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan realizes Narset might be alive in this timeline and heads to Jeskai territory to find her.
timeline.quote: She would be here. She would be alive!

timeline.summary: Sarkhan learns that the dragon Ojutai rules the Jeskai and follows word of Narset to the Dragon's Eye Sanctuary.
timeline.quote: He followed word of her name up and up, ever closer to Ojutai's roost.

timeline.summary: Master Taigam tells Sarkhan that Narset was a heretic punished to the full extent of the law and is no more.
timeline.quote: Narset is no more.

timeline.summary: Eight-year-old Narset, restless in a crowded marketplace, accidentally topples a stack of apples and is told to wait outside.
timeline.quote: She lifted her arm, holding the apple on display—as hundreds more rained down around her

timeline.summary: Free outside, Narset runs along the river and hears Ojutai's lesson across the distance, and asks to be his student; he nods.
timeline.quote: I want to be your student," she said. "Please, let me be your student."

timeline.summary: For three years Narset trains under Ojutai from afar by the riverbank.
timeline.quote: Over the next three years, Narset studied, trained, and practiced under the Great Teacher from afar.

timeline.summary: Dragonspeaker Ishai invites Narset to study at Dragon's Eye Sanctuary.
timeline.quote: To study under the Great Teacher.

timeline.summary: At fifteen, Narset defeats Taigam in a practice match and is named Master by Ojutai, the youngest he has ever named.
timeline.quote: At fifteen, she was the youngest master Ojutai had ever named.

timeline.summary: Atop the summit, Narset feels trapped by the sense that there is nothing more to learn and is unable to thank Ojutai.
timeline.quote: And just like that she was trapped.

timeline.summary: After a year of worsening restlessness, Narset descends the mountain and finds an ancient forbidden archive beneath Dragon's Eye.
timeline.quote: It had to be an ancient archive, a place that she had only heard of in legend, a place that Ojutai had all but forbidden.

timeline.summary: The scrolls contradict Ojutai's teaching by speaking of khans and dragons before him.
timeline.quote: And from what the scrolls said, it seemed that there had been dragons before Ojutai.

timeline.summary: Taigam catches Narset and threatens to report her for blasphemy, but she blasts past him.
timeline.quote: Then let him!" Narset erupted with power, blasting past Taigam and ignoring his screams.

timeline.summary: Narset searches archives under Cori Mountain and Riverwheel and learns of Ugin and the dragon tempests.
timeline.quote: She learned of a Spirit Dragon, Ugin, who was the source of all magic on the plane, as well as the dragon tempests.

timeline.summary: In the looted archive beneath Dirgur, Narset reads the last scroll about the khans' summit and discovers Ojutai led the attack on them, which also reveals Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: One of those dragons had been Ojutai.

timeline.summary: Narset's spark ignites and she is pulled toward another world, but at the last moment she pulls herself back.
timeline.quote: And then she was pulled backward with such a force as she had never felt before and ripped away from Tarkir.

timeline.summary: Years later, by the river bend, Ojutai asks Narset what she has learned, and she tells him she has learned the truth.
timeline.quote: I have learned the truth," she whispered.

timeline.summary: Narset thanks Ojutai and lets go, walking away from Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Her words were carried away on the winds of Tarkir as she let go.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan reflects, in flight, that everyone he knew lives changed, except himself and Narset, and resolves to ask Ugin.
timeline.quote: Everyone lived, it seemed, save two. Sarkhan. And Narset.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan thanks Ugin and flies off to find Narset, certain she lives again.
timeline.quote: I say she lives again, and I will find her.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan finds this timeline's Narset walking through the snow; she doesn't know him but has read secret histories about the sar-khan.
timeline.quote: About a dragon-man, a sar-khan, who came from something called the Unwritten

timeline.summary: Narset reveals she traveled beyond Tarkir; Sarkhan explains planeswalkers and that three are in the valley.
timeline.quote: Planeswalker," said Sarkhan. "That's what we're called.

timeline.summary: Narset goes to speak to Ugin and plans to study Atarka's ivory histories, content to stay on Tarkir for now; Sarkhan agrees.
timeline.quote: But this world has secrets enough. For right now…I'm right where I want to be.

timeline.summary: Narset leads Sarkhan to the Nexus and stays to hold off Zurgo, who kills her; Sarkhan swears vengeance and steps through the gate.
timeline.quote: Zurgo overpowers Narset, killing her.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan finds Ugin awake, learns he was never born in this timeline, and finds Narset, a Planeswalker exile; both are content to remain on Tarkir.
timeline.quote: both Planeswalkers agree that they are exactly where they wish to be.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo introduces Ajani as part of her story-circle and Nashi as part of her family.
timeline.quote: He's part of our family now.

timeline.summary: Narset watches a masked traveling troupe prepare in a crowded tavern near Dirgur Lake Monastery.
timeline.quote: She sat just close enough to be able to hear the two giggling to one another in a halfway familiar dialect.

timeline.summary: The troupe opens its show, and a performer is suddenly wearing a mask of Ojutai that Narset sees in her nightmares.
timeline.quote: Recognition jolted through Narset.

timeline.summary: The performer appears in a death-mask version of Narset's face as the hero of the story, and a Temur patron objects that Narset had to be persuaded.
timeline.quote: wore Narset's face, or at least the version someone would engrave onto a death mask

timeline.summary: Narset remembers her years as Ojutai's favored student and admits that in saving Tarkir she lost her dragon.
timeline.quote: In saving Tarkir, Narset lost her dragon.

timeline.summary: The performers change masks to portray the five rebellion leaders, each clan's hero.
timeline.quote: they were masked again, this time in the images of Eshki Dragonclaw and Alniul, the Twice Whisperer

timeline.summary: The crowd roars and Narset has a panic response, calming herself by counting.
timeline.quote: After a few moments, the panic eased its grip, enough that Narset could breathe again.

timeline.summary: The performers conjure a diorama of the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon and narrate the discovery of the Stormnexus Ritual; Narset recalls the desperate gamble.
timeline.quote: It'd been a gamble; they had no idea what the ritual would do.

timeline.summary: Illusory spirit dragons fly overhead as Narset reflects on each clan's dragon and on her lack of love for Shiko.
timeline.quote: But she didn't love Shiko, no, not with those wings of hers, like so many scrolls unfurling through the air

timeline.summary: Narset stops the quarrel and tells how the dragons were unformed and she first leapt onto one, binding herself to Shiko; they rode into battle and drove the dragonlords into the storm.
timeline.quote: I was the first to leap onto one.

timeline.summary: Narset warns the crowd that the dragonstorms have grown worse, reshaping the land and spawning wild dragons.
timeline.quote: They've become strong enough to reshape the very land.

timeline.summary: A breathless man bursts in seeking the waymaster and announces that a winged woman with glowing eyes has arrived.
timeline.quote: She has wings , my khan. And glowing eyes.

timeline.summary: Narset names the visitor as Elspeth and fears something terrible has happened.
timeline.quote: Her name is Elspeth,

timeline.summary: Narset greets Elspeth, who explains that dragonstorms have begun appearing across the Multiverse and asks how Tarkir kept them at bay.
timeline.quote: Dragonstorms have begun appearing throughout the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Narset reflects on Ajani, Tamiyo and her lost spark, and Elspeth recalls the cost of bringing Ajani and Nissa back.
timeline.quote: It cost everything to bring him and Nissa back.

timeline.summary: Narset shows a map of how Tarkir's dragonstorms have become more potent, with reports of scales growing on the steppes and new, hungrier dragons.
timeline.quote: So much so, they've begun to reshape Tarkir itself,

timeline.summary: Narset theorizes that Ugin's departure unleashed the stronger storms, since he served as a metaphysical ballast.
timeline.quote: It has something to do with Ugin's departure, I am sure of it.

timeline.summary: Narset refuses to modify the ritual and confesses that it may have destabilized Tarkir's balance and caused a chain reaction.
timeline.quote: it may have destabilized the delicate balance in Tarkir, resulting in a chain reaction.

timeline.summary: Bells ring and Narset announces that a wild dragon is inside the school.
timeline.quote: There's a wild dragon inside the school !

timeline.summary: Narset and Elspeth find the dragon, which has gored through the hull and is closing on six trapped youths behind a girl's barrier.
timeline.quote: it had gored its way up through the ship's hull, chewed its way through wood and metal.

timeline.summary: Elspeth dives into the dragon's mouth and drives her sword into its skull as monks rescue the children.
timeline.quote: Elspeth dove headfirst into the open maw, sword held out like a beacon.

timeline.summary: The wounded dragon flees to the deck and then off the ship while skyriders engage it.
timeline.quote: It began to writhe back, struggling to escape its attackers

timeline.summary: Elspeth says she will respect Narset's decision, and Narset promises one in the morning.
timeline.quote: I'll give you my decision in the morning.

timeline.summary: After the damage count, Narset gives Elspeth a guest room and Elspeth says Ajani spoke kindly of her.
timeline.quote: Ajani said very kind things about you.

timeline.summary: Taigam warns that Elspeth is an omen and that her arrival may have provoked the attack, and urges Narset to send her away.
timeline.quote: Send her away, Narset. As far away from the Jeskai as it is possible,

timeline.summary: Narset tells Elspeth the Jeskai cannot help, then reveals she will go herself.
timeline.quote: But I can.

timeline.summary: Narset sneaks away from the monastery with Elspeth on a young dragon eager to join the quest.
timeline.quote: And so Narset saddled the young dragon

timeline.summary: At the Crucible Narset recalls the battle against the dragonlords on Shiko, and shows Elspeth the floating hedrons.
timeline.quote: Ugin taught her how to shape them.

timeline.summary: A mysterious voice calls them to a temple as a dragonstorm gathers overhead; Narset sends her dragon away.
timeline.quote: Above, a storm began to gather, serrated clouds giving way to the suggestion of eyes, bared teeth.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan emerges at the Crucible, saying he is looking for hope in the dragonstorm and that all the Multiverse will become a realm of dragons.
timeline.quote: All of the Multiverse will become a realm of dragons.

timeline.summary: Elspeth easily defeats Sarkhan, and Narset blasts him when he springs up to stab Elspeth in the back.
timeline.quote: The blast sent Sarkhan crashing to the ground ten feet away, panting and boneless and stunned.

timeline.summary: Abzan outriders arrest Narset and Elspeth near the stormplains and take them to Arashin for questioning.
timeline.quote: Incarceration by the Abzan was not part of Narset's plan.

timeline.summary: Narset persuades an impatient Elspeth to wait one more hour, explaining the Jeskai-Abzan tension over the dead.
timeline.quote: Dromoka all but informed the Abzan that their clan would be eradicated if they didn't forswear their ancestral worship.

timeline.summary: Khan Felothar receives Narset and Elspeth before the Council of Houses and insists on lengthy hospitality, delaying their mission.
timeline.quote: We have all the time in the world.

timeline.summary: House heads squabble about trade and the waymaster's intrusion while Narset explains they are seeking a temple promised by a voice at the Crucible.
timeline.quote: we were told by a voice in the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon that there was a temple we needed to find in the dragonstorms.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and Ajani are reunited and speak of Melira's sacrifice and the past he cannot leave.
timeline.quote: She died saving me,

timeline.summary: Ajani asks Felothar to release Narset and Elspeth without waiting for consensus so they can try to quell the dragonstorms.
timeline.quote: they need to go on their way to see if there is a way to quell the dragonstorms.

timeline.summary: Felothar frees the three and announces evacuation and fortification of Arashin.
timeline.quote: You three are free to go.

timeline.summary: Narset warns that Sarkhan could bring thousands of dragons against Arashin, and the council doubts her.
timeline.quote: It will be thousands of dragons.

timeline.summary: Felothar declares the Abzan will focus on preparation and dismisses the visitors, providing them with supplies.
timeline.quote: You will be provisioned with whatever you might need.

timeline.summary: Ajani confesses to Elspeth that he joined Phyrexia willingly and apologizes for trying to kill her.
timeline.quote: I was not forced. I was not compelled. I did it willingly.

timeline.summary: Elspeth tells Ajani he was forgiven before their fight began, and Narset invites him to help stop the dragonstorms.
timeline.quote: You were forgiven before our fight even began.

timeline.summary: Ajani refuses to join them and walks away.
timeline.quote: And he was gone before Elspeth or Narset could say another word

timeline.summary: Narset and Elspeth step into the dragonstorm, shielded by blue light, and walk toward a bright light amid forming dragons.
timeline.quote: Narset stepped into the storm and Elspeth followed.

timeline.summary: The storm falls silent and they find a massive ancient temple that Narset does not recognize from any records.
timeline.quote: There is a temple in the heart of the storms,

timeline.summary: Narset and Elspeth find an Omenpath in a subterranean antechamber and step through.
timeline.quote: Nothing to do but step through, then,

timeline.summary: Elspeth sees endless water while Narset sees stairs, and they realize this Meditation Realm is a distraction hiding something.
timeline.quote: The Meditation Realm. I've been here before.

timeline.summary: Narset hears a weeping voice whispering a name, and Jace Beleren appears.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren stood on a rime of white sand

timeline.summary: Jace reveals he escaped compleation by force of will, and Narset theorizes how.
timeline.quote: I was on my way to that, yes. But I am not anymore.

timeline.summary: Jace introduces Loot, a creature whose mind holds a map of every Omenpath, and Narset questions whether Loot consented to this state.
timeline.quote: He is a map of everything .

timeline.summary: Jace evades Elspeth's question, saying he did what he needed to.
timeline.quote: What I needed to.

timeline.summary: In the present, Jace says they are trapped in the Meditation Realm, and Narset tells her companions to empty their minds so the realm stops fighting.
timeline.quote: It's our thoughts that are trapping us in this shifting space.

timeline.summary: The realm reveals Ugin and a chained dragon together.
timeline.quote: revealing two figures that Narset would have known even in death

timeline.summary: Ugin warns them away, and Bolas, who has lost his memories, says he recognizes the three and calls Jace an accomplice.
timeline.quote: That you, perhaps, were an accomplice

timeline.summary: Narset asks Ugin for help against the dragonstorms and he says he cannot.
timeline.quote: I am sorry, but there is nothing I can do.

timeline.summary: Jace reveals he wants to reverse Phyrexia's damage and control the realm; Elspeth attacks him and Narset protects her.
timeline.quote: What if I say that I can reverse everything?

timeline.summary: Narset rescues the terrified Loot as Elspeth fights Jace.
timeline.quote: I've got you,

timeline.summary: Jace explains the realm is a hub of reality that he can mold by will, to save Vraska from what Phyrexia did.
timeline.quote: This place is a substrate to all of reality, touching countless worlds and moldable by sheer force of will.

timeline.summary: Vraska appears, changed and grief-worn, and tells Jace to stop.
timeline.quote: It was Vraska herself.

timeline.summary: Jace, wielding the stolen power, shows glimpses of lost futures, but the strain breaks him and the realm begins to unmake itself.
timeline.quote: revealing a nothingness that ate at the eye

timeline.summary: Jace shatters like glass as emptiness rolls over him, and Elspeth tells Narset to run.
timeline.quote: As the emptiness rolled over him, he shattered like glass.

timeline.summary: Narset carries Loot as they flee.
timeline.quote: Narset, a wailing Loot in her arms, did as she was told.

timeline.summary: Bolas laughs as his fetters come undone and he and Ugin vanish into the nothing as the Meditation Realm burns away.
timeline.quote: Bolas and Ugin winking out of existence, eaten by the nothing, dead now, perhaps.

timeline.summary: Elspeth carries Narset and Loot through the Omenpath into the temple, where Vraska takes Loot.
timeline.quote: they were on the other side: outside the temple, Elspeth in the air, Vraska somehow beside her, arms held out for Loot.

timeline.summary: Narset climbs out and sees the sky black with dragons, and Elspeth names Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: "He's here."

timeline.summary: Vraska escapes with Loot under a camouflage spell as Narset and Elspeth decide to stand against Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: Tarkir is my home.

timeline.summary: Narset fights the dragon flock, redirecting their momentum, and recovers her inner center.
timeline.quote: Narset found what she had lost: her center

timeline.summary: Ajani, riding with Felothar, sees Narset in danger and decides to leap from his dragon.
timeline.quote: he really could just choose to do something.

timeline.summary: Ajani lands and beheads a creature about to bite Narset, and the Abzan dragons descend upon Sarkhan's flock.
timeline.quote: the dragons of the Abzan clan rose from the storm and descended upon Sarkhan's flock.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is clasped in Sarkhan's jaws while Ajani appeals to him, and Narset asks about the ritual and its sacrifice.
timeline.quote: What did you cut out of yourself to corrupt the spell?

timeline.summary: Abzan dragons suffer mounting casualties, and Narset, Ajani and Elspeth plan to blind Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: If each of us goes for one of his eyes, we might be able to blind him

timeline.summary: Ugin arrives and the wild dragons flee.
timeline.quote: The wild dragons simply fled, shrieking their terror

timeline.summary: Ugin admits he has failed to keep his brother and that Bolas is free.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas, I am afraid, is free.

timeline.summary: Ajani recounts that Jace lost control of an unidentifiable spell in the Meditation Realm and dissolved into light and energy.
timeline.quote: The spell took him, and he was gone. Just light and energy on the wind.

timeline.summary: Narset's planeswalker spark ignites, giving her the ability to walk the Blind Eternities, though her devotion stays with Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Now that Narset's Planeswalker spark has ignited, she has the ability to walk the Blind Eternities, the space between planes, and discover new worlds

timeline.summary: Narset carefully and painstakingly continues her research into the mysterious past, which might hold long-lost magic.
timeline.quote: So she carefully and painstakingly continues her research.

timeline.summary: Aided by Narset at the cost of her life, Sarkhan travels back through time to prevent Ugin's death at Bolas's hands.
timeline.quote: a way to travel back through time to the moment of Ugin's death at Nicol Bolas's hands and prevent the spirit dragon from falling.

timeline.summary: Pulled back to the present, Sarkhan finds a world ruled by dragonlords where Ugin and Narset are still alive.
timeline.quote: a world in which both Ugin and Narset were still alive.

relations.note: Narset trained Taigam when he was Jeskai.
relations.quote: He even had the honor of being trained by the khan of the Jeskai, Narset.

relations.note: Narset is khan of the Jeskai.
relations.quote: Narset, khan of the Jeskai,

relations.note: She is khan of the Jeskai.
relations.quote: Narset is the Khan of the Jeskai.

relations.note: He is her personal guard, though he also serves the elders.
relations.quote: My personal guard, Shintan, nodded at me from the edge of the pavilion.

relations.note: Her former pupil who betrayed the Jeskai for the Sultai and is said to have sent the assassins.
relations.quote: Taigam, my old pupil, who had betrayed the Jeskai to seek riches with the Sultai

relations.note: She fights and kills several of the orc assassins.
relations.quote: I had no weapons, but I had the element of surprise and years of training on these would-be assassins.

relations.note: Sarkhan's friend and kindred spirit, who died.
relations.quote: he's left behind Narset, his friend and kindred spirit, who perished at the hands of his enemy, Zurgo.

relations.note: Narset died at Zurgo's hands before the time jump.
relations.quote: who perished at the hands of his enemy, Zurgo.

relations.note: He calls her a heretic punished to the full extent of the law.
relations.quote: She was a heretic, and for that she was punished to full extent of the law.

relations.note: Her teacher, who names her Master.
relations.quote: Ojutai. Her teacher. Her dragon.

relations.note: Rival who reports her for blasphemy.
relations.quote: I have no choice but to report you for blasphemy.

relations.note: In the lost timeline, Narset fell at Zurgo's hands.
relations.quote: she fell at the hands of Zurgo Helmsmasher, the khan of the Mardu

relations.note: He hopes to be the friend of this Narset as he was of the other.
relations.quote: I am your friend—or was, and hope to be again.

relations.note: Branded a heretic by Ojutai's order.
relations.quote: You're not…some enforcer for the dragonlord, here to punish my heresy?

relations.note: In the original timeline.
relations.quote: Zurgo overpowers Narset, killing her.

relations.note: Sarkhan recognizes her as his friend.
relations.quote: He recognizes her as his friend Narset

relations.note: the waymaster, actual leader of the Jeskai
relations.quote: Narset was the waymaster—the actual leader of the Jeskai now, really

relations.note: the Great Teacher and his perfect student
relations.quote: The Great Teacher and his perfect student.

relations.note: bound to the spirit dragon she called from the ritual
relations.quote: the spirit dragon whom she'd called from the ritual, whom she'd ridden into battle against the dragonlords

relations.note: she fought the dragonlords despite loving him
relations.quote: Narset had needed convincing.

relations.note: found the Stormnexus Ritual together
relations.quote: Along with wise Alniul had discovered an ancient spell

relations.note: waymaster of the Jeskai
relations.quote: I am Narset, waymaster of the Jeskai.

relations.note: shared friends; they fight the dragon together
relations.quote: We've shared many friends in common.

pages_say.description: The khan of the Jeskai who once trained Taigam and called him one of her most adept students.
The Khan of the Jeskai, younger than the other elders, who feels like an outsider, hides her emotions, and studies history for a way to heal Tarkir.
Sarkhan's friend and kindred spirit who died at the hands of Zurgo before the time jump.
A Jeskai khan Sarkhan knew in his own time, described as gentle and seeking knowledge.
A Jeskai figure Sarkhan hoped would live in the new Tarkir, but who was punished as a heretic and is dead.
A restless, brilliant woman of the dragon-ruled Tarkir who becomes Ojutai's youngest master, learns the truth about his past in the archives, ignites her planeswalker spark, and finally walks away.
This timeline's Narset, a Planeswalker branded a heretic by Ojutai, who has traveled beyond Tarkir and knows of Sarkhan from secret histories.
The Jeskai khan who dies at Zurgo's hands in the original timeline, and a Planeswalker exile in the new one who recognizes Sarkhan.
A member of Tamiyo's story-circle who tells stories and can walk behind the air.
A planeswalker and the waymaster, the actual leader of the Jeskai, who watches a troupe dramatize the rebellion in which she took part, then corrects their story.
A former planeswalker, now waymaster of the Jeskai, whose spark guttered out; she fears her ritual destabilized Tarkir but ends by deciding to help Elspeth.
Waymaster of the Jeskai who leaves Storm Crane secretly with Elspeth to investigate the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon.
Waymaster of the Jeskai, detained by Abzan scouts and brought to Khan Felothar's court.
Waymaster of the Jeskai who leads Elspeth through the dragonstorms to a hidden temple and the Meditation Realm.
Waymaster of the Jeskai who reveals the true form of the Meditation Realm, helps stop Jace and rescues Loot.
Waymaster of the Jeskai who fights Sarkhan's dragons and rediscovers her center.
A planeswalker who helped Ajani stop the dragonstorms on Tarkir.
A planeswalker whose spark has ignited but whose devotion is to her home plane of Tarkir and her clan; she patiently researches the mysterious past.
The Jeskai khan who aided Sarkhan at the cost of her life; she is alive again after the timeline change.
